list.name: Changes
list.comment:
Set up project environment
- Configured essential components: Cache, Security, and Filters - Implemented controller structure with AuthController and custom error handling - Set up DTOs for request and response models (LoginRequest, RegisterRequest, ApiResponse, etc.) - Established exception handling mechanism with centralized ErrorHandler - Added models, repository layer for database interaction (UserRepository, AcmePlexUser) - Included services for user authentication and token management (AcmeUserDetailsService, AuthTokenUtil) - Configured logging through StartupLogger for application initialization logging
